subject: general
question:
**Directions : **Each question in this section has three parts (a), (b) and (c). Find out whether there is any error in any part and mark your responses accordingly.

Everybody, (a) / it must be admitted (b) / has their ups and downs (c) / no error (d)
solution:
The correct answer is "**c**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence **"Everybody, it must be admitted, has their ups and downs**" contains an error in **part (c)** regarding agreement in number between the pronoun and the antecedent.
 
• The antecedent "**everybody**" is an** indefinite pronoun** that is always **singular**,
